meta.title: Share link import
meta.description: Turn a public DeepSeek chat share link into a real, resumable Session. Click the ⤓ button to the right of New session, paste https://chat.deepseek.com/share/<id> (or just the id), pick the target workspace, and click Import. The link is read through the site's public share endpoint, so no login, token, or export ZIP is needed; nothing is sent to a model and no turn stays open. Questions, reasoning, web-search sources, and answers are stored as static history, so the first follow-up sends the whole imported conversation. Search results are trimmed (8 results per search, 120-character snippets) to keep a long session usable. Public, unexpired shares only; one import at a time. Turning the plugin off removes the button and the import route but keeps the sessions already imported.
